name: context-assumption
description: Provisional project assumptions with explicit verification conditions and evidence-bound lifecycle transitions.

interface.shortDescription: Track unverified premises without treating them as facts.
interface.longDescription: Captures project-scoped assumptions as provisional artifacts, recalls them only on a relevant signal, and confirms, refutes, supersedes, or annotates them through context-core approval and storage.
defaultPrompt: Require the exact installed and enabled context-core@context-plugins source, context-common/v2 protocol, and context-owner-descriptor/v2 feature before any non-static operation.
Claim only an explicitly unverified project assumption; decline observed facts, evidence claims, accepted choices, and decisions.
Use search/read only after an assumption-relevant signal, compare actual primary claims for same_claim, and never use IDs, hashes, fingerprints, or index metadata as semantic evidence.
Produce owner results and validation receipts only; delegate every repository write, index update, CAS check, lock, and apply to context-core after exact approval_digest approval.
